speaker: Ms Anthea Ong
text: asked the Minister for Trade and Industry (a) whether there are plans to reduce greenhouse emissions by industries; (b) how much fossil fuel is (i) imported into and (ii) refined in Singapore every year; (c) how do the volumes in (b) measure up against Singapore's annual carbon emissions; (d) how much percentage increase in carbon emissions is expected following an expansion of refinery facilities; and (e) what is the strategic plan to support industries to make the urgent shifts to changing market and consumer demands to promote climate crisis responsibility.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: The rest is largely for power generation and transportation.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: To achieve this, we have to make our economy much more carbon-efficient.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: For existing industries, we are encouraging companies to adopt energy-efficient technologies.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: This year, we implemented an enhanced set of Industry Energy Efficiency schemes.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: NEA is also planning to launch a new grant to help companies digitalise their energy management systems.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: When firms expand their operations or new firms invest in Singapore, the Government works closely with them to ensure a high standard of efficiency.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: For instance, the Government supported the Singapore Refining Company's (SRC's) upgrade on Jurong Island, including its co-generation plant, which has led to greater energy efficiency, higher quality products and reduced sulphur oxide emissions.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: This is also the case for ExxonMobil’s recent expansion of its Singapore manufacturing complex, which is one of the most efficient refineries globally.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: Beyond the refineries and petrochemicals sector, we also encourage companies in other sectors to be energy-efficient.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: For instance, Facebook’s first data centre in Singapore will be a leader in energy efficiency, with features that also minimise the use of land and water.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: But beyond industries, all of us, as consumers, as citizens, have a responsibility to mitigate climate change.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: For example, saving electricity, using public transport and reducing waste are good ways to cut carbon emissions.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: As a country, we will do our part to help address global climate change and global climate challenges.

speaker: Ms Anthea Ong (Nominated Member)
text: Can I just find out if part (d) on how much percentage increase in carbon emissions is expected following an expansion of refinery facilities has been answered, please?

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: So, that is not something that I am able to share with the Member at the moment.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: I believe that takes into account the whole of Singapore's emissions.
